name: Eklavya Gupta
summary: Product Engineer with hands-on experience in LLM agents, hybrid search, and backend optimization. Seeking backend or AI engineering roles targeting meaningful performance and product outcomes.

bullets: Architected and deployed a LangGraph-based AI agent on AWS AgentCore Runtime with integrated short-term conversational memory, enabling stateful, context-aware interactions across multi-turn sessions in the LifeSciences domain.

Designed and implemented a hybrid retrieval pipeline (BM25 + Semantic Search → Stage-1 Reranking → Stage-2 ACE Reranking) for medical coding queries within an MCP server, improving top-k retrieval accuracy from ~60% to 95%+.

Led experimentation using ACE (Agentic Context Engineering) — a domain adaptation framework comprising Generator, Reflector, and Curator stages — achieving 80% accuracy in medical coding, driving measurable gains in specialized LifeSciences NLP tasks.

Optimized the ACE training pipeline by 3–5×, reducing end-to-end domain adaptation time from 24 hours to 5–6 hours for equivalent record volumes through script-level parallelism and compute optimizations.

Reduced full inferencing pipeline runtime by 75% (8 hours → 2 hours) by introducing concurrency at database and network call layers and applying result caching on static/deterministic functions within the MCP server pipeline.
Automated end-to-end CI/CD for the agent and MCP server using Jenkins, eliminating manual deployment overhead and standardizing release workflows.
Built an AWS Lambda-based memory snapshot service to back up AgentCore conversational memory, ensuring data durability and recovery for production agent sessions.

Developed a production-ready FastAPI application with async/await patterns, implementing RESTful APIs for content generation and document processing. Integrated multiple AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic) with vector database (Pinecone) for semantic search and knowledge retrieval.
Architected a modular backend system with 12+ specialized services including content generation, compliance checking, and knowledge base management.
Implemented dependency injection and service layer patterns for maintainable code structure.
Implemented structured data validation using Pydantic schemas and built custom tool execution framework for AI function calling.
Created automated content generation workflows with concern resolution and quality assurance processes.

Developed a Python & Flask server for decoding and processing frames from RTSP feeds from 500+ CCTV cameras, providing real-time insights, and leveraged Redis Pub/Sub architecture to ensure scalability.
Embedded post-inferencing performance monitoring with a human in the loop, increasing system reliability and reducing error rates by 30% in a month.
Built a Redis microservice for batch inferencing YOLO model on camera frames, reducing GPU costs by 40%, along with CI/CD and AWS EC2 deployment.

projects.name: Repel
bullets: Built Repel, a full-stack web app demonstrating how LLMs can enable scalable code generation and execution for broader projects.
Integrated an in-browser code editor with Monaco and executed code securely using Web Containers.

projects.name: One-Shot Learning – Face Net Paper
bullets: Built a custom architecture using Inception layers and point-wise convolutions to generate compact face embeddings.
Implemented Triplet Loss to learn similarity metrics, minimizing intra-class distance and maximizing inter-class separation.
